name: Kagura Reimeiki ~Maika no Shou~
source:
Toono Maika, a shrine maiden training in exorcism at Kijimori Shrine.

One day, she was given a special mission by the shrine.
Recently, shrines once affiliated with renowned exorcist shrine maidens had been attacked one after another.
The shrine asked her to investigate these incidents.
This wasn’t just some random supernatural occurrence—it might be something far more serious.
And so, Maika began her investigation.

[Translated from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/pro/work/=/product_id/VJ012209.html/]dlsite[/url]]
translation:
远野舞香，在木地森神社接受驱魔训练的巫女。

有一天，神社赋予了她一项特殊的使命。
最近，曾经供奉着著名驱魔巫女的神社接连遭到袭击。
神社要求她调查这些事件。
这不仅仅是一些随机的超自然事件——它可能是更严重的事情。
于是，麦卡开始了她的调查。
